profit_quality.assessment: 2025 reported profit turned positive and operating cash flow was strong, but the denominator is based on only one clean post-listing profitable year. A large part of reported profit relates to non-operating financial asset gains, interest and dividend income; trade receivables remain large and slow.
adjustments: Started from 2025 parent net profit RMB285.738 million.
Removed fair value gains on financial assets at FVTPL, interest income, dividend income and government grants on an after-tax approximate basis.
Used RMB214.4 million as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit; depreciation was not added back because AI terminal replacement capex is an ongoing operating requirement.
Applied 0.70 profit haircut because 2025 cash conversion is good, but receivable turnover is 155.6 days, ECL allowance is RMB89.363 million, and the company has limited listed annual history.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 operating cash flow was RMB368.947 million versus parent net profit RMB285.738 million; cash purchase of PPE was RMB10.840 million and PPE additions were RMB39.843 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Positive operating cash flow supports a non-null denominator, but receivable quality, short listed history and non-operating gains require a material haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2025 operating cash flow / parent net profit was about 1.29x, but receivables increased by RMB124.581 million and the gross trade receivable balance carried RMB89.363 million ECL allowance.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: PPE additions were RMB39.843 million and cash purchases of PPE were RMB10.840 million; no explicit maintenance/growth split was disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working-capital changes in the cash-flow statement were near neutral overall, but high trade receivables and long credit terms justify discounting profit instead of using the best-year cash flow directly.
